title: Committee of Supply debate on the Ministry of Education budget
what_it_is: A Committee of Supply debate on Head K, the Ministry of Education, with Members moving cuts and the Minister and Ministers of State responding.
why_it_matters: The debate records changes to primary and secondary education, including the GEP refresh, a single Post-Secondary Admissions Exercise from 2028, Higher Mother Tongue eligibility from Secondary 1, and more financial assistance for lower- to middle-income students from Academic Year 2026. It also records reviews of Primary 1 registration, class sizes, milestone exams and DSA, and a salary review for educators.

key_points.point: Mr Darryl David moved a $100 cut to Head K, the Ministry of Education.
key_points.speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
key_points.quote: That the total sum to be allocated for Head K of the Estimates be reduced by $100

key_points.point: The Gifted Education Programme will be discontinued in its current form and support for academically strong students refreshed.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: we will refresh how we support students with academic strengths and talents, and discontinue the Gifted Education Programme (GEP) in its current form.

key_points.point: Access to school-based programmes for academically strong students will be broadened from around 7% to 10% of the cohort.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: we will broaden access to such school-based programmes, from around 7% of the cohort today to 10%.

key_points.point: There will be 15 centres hosted by primary schools for after-school advanced modules.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: there will be 15 centres hosted by primary schools across Singapore

key_points.point: The first batch of Primary 3 students will take a standardised one-stage identification exercise this August.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: The first batch of Primary 3 students will participate in a standardised one-stage identification exercise this August

key_points.point: Students can join the centre-based modules at the end of each semester at Primary 4 and Primary 5.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: students can also join at the end of each semester at Primary 4 and Primary 5

key_points.point: From Academic Year 2026, income eligibility and financial assistance amounts were raised to benefit 31,000 more students, with about 133,000 students benefiting annually.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: From Academic Year 2026, we raised the income eligibility criteria and financial assistance amount for Singaporean students to benefit 31,000 more students from lower- to middle-income households.

key_points.point: From 2026, schools with additional manpower and funding will expand from 100 to 157.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: From this year 2026, we will devote even more resources to schools, expanding the number of schools with additional manpower and funding, from 100 to 157.

key_points.point: The first Full SBB cohort will sit the SEC examination in 2027.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: The first cohort of students under Full SBB will be sitting for the Singapore-Cambridge Secondary Education Certificate (SEC) examination in 2027

key_points.point: Admissions to junior colleges, Millennia Institute, polytechnics and ITE will be streamlined into a single Post-Secondary Admissions Exercise in 2028.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: streamline several admissions exercises into a single Post-Secondary Admissions Exercise for admissions to junior colleges, Millennia Institute, polytechnics and the Institute of Technical Education (ITE) in the year 2028

key_points.point: Students who did well in Mother Tongue at PSLE can take Higher Mother Tongue from Secondary 1 regardless of overall PSLE score.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: allow students who did well in Mother Tongue at the Primary School Leaving Examinations (PSLE) to take up Higher Mother Tongue from Secondary 1, regardless of their overall PSLE score.

key_points.point: MOE is reviewing the Primary 1 Registration Framework.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: MOE is reviewing the Primary 1 Registration Framework so that our primary schools remain open to students from different backgrounds.

key_points.point: MOE will start a series of Education Conversations.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: we will start a series of Education Conversations.

key_points.point: SkillsFuture Singapore and Workforce Singapore will be reorganised into a new Statutory Board jointly overseen by MOM and MOE.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG) and Workforce Singapore (WSG) would be reorganised into a new Statutory Board, jointly overseen by the Ministry of Manpower (MOM) and MOE.

key_points.point: MOE is reviewing salaries of educators, including Allied Educators and MOE Kindergarten Educators.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: MOE is reviewing the salaries of our educators, including our Allied Educators and MOE Kindergarten Educators and will share more when ready.

key_points.point: Mr Desmond Lee set out four 'Learns' for AI, beginning with learning about AI.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: First, learn about AI.

key_points.point: Choice order will be a posting tie-breaker for the new PSE, in the order citizenship, choice order, gross aggregate score and computerised balloting.
key_points.speaker: Mr David Neo
key_points.quote: choice order will be introduced as a posting tie-breaker for the PSE in this order: citizenship, choice order, gross aggregate score and computerised balloting.

key_points.point: The 2027 SEC cohort will receive results in January 2028 and apply through the new PSE.
key_points.speaker: Mr David Neo
key_points.quote: The 2027 SEC cohort will receive their SEC results in January 2028 and apply for their post-secondary course options through this new PSE.

key_points.point: Under Full SBB, separate Express, Normal (Academic) and Normal (Technical) courses have been done away with.
key_points.speaker: Mr David Neo
key_points.quote: Under Full SBB, we have done away with separate Express, Normal (Academic) and Normal (Technical) courses

key_points.point: Canoeing was added to the Strategic Partnership CCA programme last year, and Hockey is being introduced this year.
key_points.speaker: Mr David Neo
key_points.quote: Last year, we added Canoeing to the list. This year, we are introducing Hockey.

key_points.point: Funding for the Mother Tongue Language Learning and Promotion Committees will increase over the next five years.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: we will increase funding for the Mother Tongue Language Learning and Promotion Committees over the next five years

key_points.point: The average form class size is 34 in primary schools and 33 in secondary schools.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: The average form class size for primary and secondary schools is 34 and 33 today, respectively.

key_points.point: Teacher recruitment has been ramped up to a target of over 1,000 new teachers a year.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: We have already ramped up teacher recruitment significantly – from 700 the year previously, to a current target of over 1,000 new teachers a year.

key_points.point: Allied educators in priority areas have doubled over the last 10 years, from about 800 to 1,600.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: we have doubled the number of allied educators in priority areas, such as counselling and special education needs across all schools, over the last 10 years, from about 800 to 1,600.

key_points.point: Deployment of allied educators in teaching and learning has been progressively scaled back.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: we have been progressively scaling back the deployment of allied educators in teaching and learning

key_points.point: CCAs are an important part of holistic development and teachers' role in CCAs is not merely administrative.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: CCAs are an important part of holistic development and our teachers' role in CCAs are not merely administrative.

key_points.point: SEN officers increased from about 450 in 2017 to about 750 by 2024.
key_points.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
key_points.quote: SEN officers have increased from about 450 in 2017 to about 750 by 2024.

key_points.point: SPED school capacity will increase from 8,300 in 2024 to 10,000 places by 2030.
key_points.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
key_points.quote: Capacity will increase from 8,300 in 2024, to 10,000 places by 2030.

key_points.point: SPED salary guidelines were reviewed and enhanced with salary enhancements from 2024 to 2026.
key_points.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
key_points.quote: we have reviewed and enhanced the salary guidelines with salary enhancements from 2024 to 2026.

key_points.point: MOE is exploring mixed mode cooling for classrooms as the science becomes clearer.
key_points.speaker: Mr David Neo
key_points.quote: This includes exploring mixed mode cooling for classrooms as the science becomes clearer.

key_points.point: Primary 3 to 6 students currently have 2.5 hours of PE classes per week.
key_points.speaker: Mr David Neo
key_points.quote: Primary 3 to 6 students have 2.5 hours of PE classes per week.

key_points.point: At the primary level, AI exposure will focus firmly on fundamentals.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: At the primary level, the focus will remain firmly on fundamentals

key_points.point: Teachers for centre-based advanced modules will be pooled from different schools, including former GEP teachers, centrally held in MOE HQ and deployed to centres.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: The teachers will be pooled from different schools, including some former GEP teachers, centrally held in MOE HQ, and then deployed to teach at various centres.

key_points.point: MOE can work more closely with the High Performance Sport Institute and national sports associations on student athletes.
key_points.speaker: Mr David Neo
key_points.quote: there is room for MOE to work more closely together with the High Performance Sport Institute, and all the national sports associations

key_points.point: A location filter for the MySkillsFuture portal search facility can be explored.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: we can certainly explore the possibility of a location filter in the portal search facility.

key_points.point: MOE will consider the request for an ITE or lifelong learning centre in the north.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: We will consider the Member's request.

key_points.point: Mr Desmond Lee gave the PSLE mathematics answer as 7,200 cubic centimetres for part (a) and 32 centimetres for part (b).
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: For (a), it is 7,200 cubic centimetres; for (b), it is 32 centimetres.

key_points.point: Mr Darryl David asked for leave to withdraw his cut.
key_points.speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
key_points.quote: I ask for leave to withdraw my cut.

what_happens_next: Mr Darryl David asked for leave to withdraw his cut. MOE said more details will be shared when ready on the Primary 1 Registration Framework review, salary review and Education Conversations. The 2027 SEC cohort will receive results in January 2028 and apply through the new PSE, with posting outcomes by early February.
